t: A long list, and then two images
a: اللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْ عَنِّي خَطَايَاىَ بِمَاءِ الثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ، وَنَقِّ قَلْبِي مِنَ الْخَطَايَا، كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، وَبَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَاىَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ
p: Allāhumma-ghsil ʿannī khaṭāyāya bi-māʾi-th-thalji wa-l-barad, wa naqqi qalbī mina-l-khaṭāyā kamā naqqayta-th-thawba-l-abyaḍa mina-d-danas, wa bāʿid baynī wa bayna khaṭāyāya kamā bāʿadta bayna-l-mashriqi wa-l-maghrib
m: O Allah, wash my wrongs from me with the water of snow and hail. Clean my heart of wrongs as You clean a white garment of dirt. And put distance between me and my wrongs as You have put distance between the east and the west.
